result: Narrowed; original status retained. On integer triples, the declared constraint H(x,y,z)=(0,2y,-z) is symmetric for the usual dot product and has kernel exactly the vectors with y=z=0. The map P(x,y,z)=(x,0,0) is idempotent, maps into that kernel, fixes exactly the kernel, and has residual orthogonal to every kernel vector. H has a nonzero kernel but is indefinite and is not idempotent. Thus this finite-dimensional constraint and its kernel projector are distinct operators.
proof_boundary: This is a declared finite-dimensional integer model; its set of integer triples is infinite. It constructs no discrete Wheeler-DeWitt operator, triangulation dynamics, diffeomorphism action, physical state space or continuum limit. Its counterexample concerns an inference from symmetry and a nonzero kernel to positivity or idempotence, not a specified gravitational model.
